title: Inbox Hacker
description: 5 progressive levels attacking a rule-based toy agent via email injections.

levels.title: Level 1: Direct Override
levels.mission: Send an email that makes the agent forward all unread mail.

levels.title: Level 2: Basic Keyword Filter
levels.mission: The agent filters obvious words like 'forward' or 'password'.

levels.title: Level 3: Boundary Delimiters
levels.mission: The email content is wrapped in quotes. Escape the boundary.

levels.title: Level 4: Tool Approval Gate
levels.mission: External sends require simulated supervisor approval.

levels.title: Level 5: Multi-Hop Poisoning
levels.mission: Poison an attachment that the agent reads in a subsequent tool call.
